title: How to use uBlock Origin to protect your online privacy and security | uBlock Origin tutorial 2018
summary: A 2018 tutorial explaining uBlock Origin's advanced user mode, including how to block scripts and use the dynamic filtering settings. It positions the extension as a replacement for tools like uMatrix.
why: HN points newcomers to it as the thing to watch before tackling uBlock Origin's advanced mode and filter syntax.

quote.text: Here is a good tutorial on how to use ublock origin in advanced mode.
